description: Tier-2 control route, conduit / mid branch. Common biome order (plains -> forest -> swamp -> mountain -> cave -> jungle -> desert) held constant; the range node is the only variable across this class's three variants. Hypothesis: OPEN QUESTION, held deliberately neutral. Conduit's damage runs through minions that inherit player stats, so whether it prefers a slow high-attack weapon or a fast one depends on whether inheritance is per-hit or throughput-based -- see the Conduit scaling note. This plan takes the high-attack Cave axe and records the result rather than guessing; the fast-weapon arm is the paired probe.
